description: This file contains utility functions for obtaining and detecting the user's geolocation using the browser's navigator.geolocation API. It provides promise-based methods to get the current position with configurable options and to standardize location data for the application.

methods.name: getCurrentPosition(options = {})
methods.description: A promise-based wrapper that retrieves the user's current geographic position, with support for timeout and high accuracy options.

methods.name: detectMyLocation(options = {})
methods.description: An asynchronous function that uses getCurrentPosition to detect the user's location and returns an object with standardized location data, including a label, latitude, and longitude.
